exercises.question: Which sentence expresses a past regret accurately using *debería haber*?
options: Debería haber guardado una copia del archivo antes de salir.
Debería guardar una copia del archivo antes de salir.
Debería haber guardada una copia del archivo antes de salir.
Debería haber guardando una copia del archivo antes de salir.

exercises.sentence: Tendrías que _____ avisado del tropiezo en cuanto falló la pantalla.
exercises.english: You should have warned about the slip-up as soon as the screen failed.

exercises.sentence: Si no _____ guardado aquel respaldo, todo el trabajo habría sido en vano.
exercises.english: If we hadn't saved that backup, all the work would have been in vain.

exercises.sentence: No te voy a reprochar el tropiezo, pero el arrepentimiento llega cuando dejamos el envío a última hora.
options: I'm not going to blame you for the slip-up, but regret comes when we leave the dispatch to the last minute.
I'm going to blame you for the slip-up, because regret comes when we leave the dispatch to the last minute.
I'm not going to blame you for the slip-up, but relief comes when we leave the dispatch to the last minute.

exercises.question: Which expression means 'in vain' (without achieving the intended result)?
options: en vano
de sobra
por si acaso
sobre aviso

exercises.question: Why did Carlos warn his colleague at three o'clock?
options: Because the client had moved the deadline to the following week without notice.
Because they had not yet checked the final attachment and risked a penalty if it went out late.
Because his colleague wanted to cancel the whole contract and start a new project.

exercises.question: What saved the team when the main file failed twenty minutes before the deadline?
options: Carlos had saved a backup copy earlier that morning just in case.
The client agreed to extend the deadline until the next morning.
A technical team repaired the office network within two minutes.

exercises.question: How did Carlos and his colleague feel once the confirmation email arrived?
options: Angry at each other for wasting the whole afternoon in vain.
Worried that the client would still charge them a surcharge.
Relieved that it went through and agreed to check earlier.

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: ¿Pasaste un mal momento con el fallo técnico de la oficina?

options: Sí, qué alivio: si no hubiéramos tenido el respaldo, habríamos perdido la entrega.
Sí, qué alivio: si no habríamos tenido el respaldo, habríamos perdido la entrega.
Sí, qué alivio: si no tuvimos el respaldo, habríamos perdido la entrega.

exercises.english: I regret having postponed the dispatch.

exercises.question: Which sentence expresses a past counterfactual near miss accurately?
options: Si hubiéramos revisado el anexo al mediodía, habríamos evitado aquel tropiezo.
Si habríamos revisado el anexo al mediodía, habríamos evitado aquel tropiezo.
Si hubiéramos revisado el anexo al mediodía, habremos evitado aquel tropiezo.
Si revisábamos el anexo al mediodía, habríamos evitado aquel tropiezo.
